interface.signature:
n m k
a1 a2 ... an

postconditions.description: m is a positive integer within the given constraints.
k is a positive integer within the given constraints.
The product of m and k is less than or equal to n, within the given constraints.
Each element in the array a is an integer within the given constraints.

invariants.expression: all(ai == a[i-1] for i in range(1, n+1))
invariants.description: The array a is a list of integers.
The number of elements in the array a is at least m*k.
